accent.job: The armed tool and the one primary action of a view, and the focus ring's light band; it always touches ink and never sits on the page.

light.note: Recto's own renderer: an in-house WebGL 1 aurora at 1/8 resolution with a ±0.5 LSB in-shader dither and P3 stops where supported (ADR-0025). Colour follows intensity, teal through mint and lime to lemon at the hottest cores. Still at rest; it moves on arrival, drag-over and success and settles within 5 s; it drifts only on the empty Library and About, and never comes within 64 px of a page. The cap is the kit's ceiling, not a Recto value: Recto caps the field at 0.6 under lit glass and has its own intensity model. The gradient is the mark's (the Dengeli R), not a fill: the accent itself is the one lime #c8fb3d, and #bbed26 is the aurora's lime, never a button.

motion.note: Recto's tokens press, smooth, glide and pop, read in the family's four roles; nothing is renamed. Recto also has quick (0.28 s), fling (0.40 s, bounce 0.15) and track (0.10 s). Zero bounce for anything a click, tap or key starts; pop is for one small glyph, never a surface. CSS durations to 0.1 %: press 300 ms, smooth 530, glide 680, pop 410; View Transitions 240 ms; idle frames = 0. The signature is the capsule morph: one glass pill changes its own width and height (dock, Markup palette, Pages bar, Compare, Locked) on smooth, radius 999 throughout.

promise.evidence: The privacy shield in the top strip lists every request the session made ("Privacy: nothing has left this device"); About's "Check it yourself" section shows how to verify it in the browser's network panel.
